assessment: This manuscript reports valuable tools and data to study DNA repair and its regulation in life cells by generating and validating cell lines with Halo-tag fusions to the chromosomal genes encoding ATM, NBS1, MDC1, RNF168, RNF169, 53BP1, RIF1, SHLD3, REV7, SHLD2, SHLD1, and DNA-PKcs. The data establish the utility of most of the tools but remain incomplete. Conclusions from the kinetic analysis would benefit from more validation by genetic experiments and the single particle tracking analysis offers more potential for analysis.
